naming.J_s_k: held-out predictive gain (bits per joint query) of the state at position k about the source's joint local future -- NOT mutual information
naming.retention_ratio: R_{s->k} = J_{s->k} / J_{s->s} -- predictive-signal retention ratio
naming.RootGain_h: predictive gain at the root of the h-hop source signal
naming.R_source: R_{s->s} = 1 is only the normalisation origin; it does not mean the source carries one bit
naming.p_signflip: paired time-block sign-flip randomization p-value (one-sided, pre-registered direction)
naming.p_tail_boot: Monte-Carlo bootstrap tail probability (descriptive; not a sign test, not used for the Holm decision)
